snippet.title: Around The World (Ketchapp)
snippet.description:
iOS : https://itunes.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1006496491?pt=1250360&ct=Youtube&mt=8

Android : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ketchapp.aroundtheworld

What do birds like to do? Exactly, they like to travel around the world.

→ Hold the screen to speed up your bird
→ Avoid dangerous red rocks!
→ Unlock all the birds and discover all locations!
